Simulated Lee-Carter data with known truth

Source: R/data-example.R
simulate_lc_dgp.Rd

The Lee-Carter model with Poisson deaths (Brouhns, Denuit and Vermunt 2002): log m = a_x + b_x k_t + shift_g, deaths Poisson with mean m * exposure, with k_t a random walk with drift (-0.015, sd 0.02) per stratum, 5-year age groups 30-34 ... 90-94 and 10 strata (2 sexes x 5 deprivation quintiles). sd_obs > 0 adds iid normal noise to the log rates before the Poisson draw (the generator of the 0.1 review used 0.03), for studies of misspecified models.

Usage

simulate_lc_dgp(
  n_t = 40,
  seed = 1,
  pop = 2e+05,
  sd_k = 0.02,
  drift = -0.015,
  sd_obs = 0
)

Arguments

n_t

Number of years.

seed

Random seed.

pop

Population at age 30 per stratum.

sd_k, drift

Standard deviation and drift of the random walk k_t.

sd_obs

Standard deviation of iid noise on the log rates (0: none, the Lee-Carter model with Poisson deaths).

Value

An mt_data object.
